Abbott call a special election for Texas’ 23rd Congressional District? David Martin Davies , 5 hours ago The 23rd Congressional District is now without a voting representative in Washington after U.S. Rep. Tony Gonzales resigned Tuesday. The vacancy has national implications for the GOP’s hold on power in Congress. Government / Politics Rep. Tony Gonzales admits affair with former staffer who died by suicide; under House ethics investigation David Martin Davies , March 4, 2026 The San Antonio Republican acknowledged the relationship publicly for the first time as the House Ethics Committee probes allegations involving the former aide. Government / Politics Gonzales and Herrera go to runoff in the 23rd David Martin Davies , March 4, 2026 Scandal-battered Republican Rep. Tony Gonzales survived his primary fight and will advance to a May 26 runoff against challenger Brandon Herrera, keeping alive his bid for a fourth term in one of the nation’s most closely watched House races. On the Democratic side, Katy Padilla Stout won her party’s nomination. News Calls grow for Rep. Tony Gonzales to resign David Martin Davies , February 18, 2026 Calls are growing for Tony Gonzales to resign after the San Antonio Express-News published a report alleging the congressman had an affair with a member of his staff, Regina Santos-Aviles, who later took her own life. Crime & Justice Death of Regina Santos-Aviles ruled a suicide TPR Staff , November 10, 2025 The Bexar County Medical Examiner’s Office has ruled the death of Regina Santos-Aviles, a congressional staffer for U.S. Representative Tony Gonzales, a suicide by self-immolation. Government / Politics Uvalde PD investigation into death of staffer to Rep. Tony Gonzales expected to conclude Lauren McGaughy | The Texas Newsroom, TPR Staff , October 30, 2025 The investigation into the death of 35-year-old Regina Santos-Aviles is expected to conclude without criminal charges. Government / Politics Rep. Tony Gonzales, R-Texas, on the effects of the shutdown on military families Steve Inskeep , October 20, 2025 NPR's Steve Inskeep asks Republican Rep. Tony Gonzales of Texas about the impact of the government shutdown on his constituents, including military families in the state. Listen • 5:35 Government / Politics San Antonio loses one congressional seat under GOP redistricting plan Josh Peck , August 1, 2025 Changes to San Antonio-area districts go after Democratic Rep. Henry Cuellar in CD 28 and Democratic Rep. Greg Casar in CD 35. Government / Politics Texas Republicans plan to redraw congressional districts during the special legislative session Josh Peck , July 17, 2025 Gov. Greg Abbott has added congressional redistricting to the state legislature's upcoming special session at President Donald Trump's request to create new Republican seats. One expert said it's an unusual and risky move. News Republican Rep. Tony Gonzales predicts GOP will lose control of the House Jasper Scherer and Kayla Kuo | The Texas Tribune , September 6, 2024 Gonzales, who represents a Texas border district, tells a Tribune Festival audience that his own party will be to blame for defeats in the November election.
